description: Source file containing unit tests for the MacNodeRuntime component of the OpenClaw project, including tests for command handling, environment override restrictions, camera and screen recording functionalities, and browser proxy interactions.

classes.name: FakeMainActorServices
classes.description: A mock implementation of MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices for testing screen recording and location services, injected into MacNodeRuntime.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Simulates screen recording by writing 'ok' to a temporary file and returning its path.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns CLAuthorizationStatus as authorizedAlways, simulating granted location permissions.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns CLAccuracyAuthorization as fullAccuracy for precise location data.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Returns a fixed CLLocation at latitude 0 and longitude 0.
